text:
Alex P: Hey team — draft of the product launch post is up: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XxExampleLink. Need quick reviews and legal sign-off by EOD so we can hit Monday publish.
Maria G: Skimmed it. Overall great narrative. Two things: the benchmark callout needs a source note, and the webinar CTA could be clearer (what will attendees see?).
Jordan K: For the benchmark "48% cost reduction" line, we should add a parenthetical like '(vs. baseline A, internal perf test 2026-03)'. @Legal - Tina can you confirm if that phrasing is okay?
Legal - Tina: Need baseline spelled out and test date. Can't approve percentage claims without a linked test note or appendix. Also avoid absolutes like 'guaranteed' or 'enterprise-grade' without qualifiers.
Priya S: For the webinar CTA — suggestion: "Join our live demo + ask the infra team" and pre-fill model param on the landing page so demos are contextual. Example pre-fill: 
```
https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=product_launch&utm_content=register&model=redwood-v1&lead_source=blog_post
```
Sam L: Parallel note for lead routing: add `lead_source=blog_post` and `campaign=product_launch_mar26` so SFDC mapping is deterministic. I'll add the mapping to the routing sheet.
Maria G: Headline suggestion — current is "New: Redwood Inference Dedicated" which feels dry. How about "Predictable LLM inference for production" or "Inference that scales with your product"? Shorter could be better.
Alex P: I prefer "Predictable LLM inference for production" — more product-y. Jordan — can you drop two hero stats under the header (throughput and cost) + one-line explainer?
Jordan K: Added: "2.1x median throughput, 48% lower per-token cost on our standard trace (n=50k)". I uploaded the test notes and CSVs to the doc appendix and linked the raw logs.
Legal - Tina: Thanks — I'll review the appendix. If the baseline and methodology are in the doc, I can sign off and add an approval comment.
marketing-bot: Reminder — content freeze at 17:00 PT today for the Monday publish window.
Priya S: Timeline check: webinar landing needs to be live by Friday EOD so we can start ads and PR outreach Monday. @Sam L can you confirm lead capture webhook + SFDC fields by Friday?
Sam L: Confirmed. I'll post the webhook payload and field mapping in the routing sheet by EOD Friday. Also will include test instructions for QA.
Alex P: Action list: Jordan — finalize benchmark footnote and attach raw logs; Maria — finalize headline and CTAs; Priya — build webinar landing + pre-fill links; Sam — finalize lead routing and webhook; Tina — legal final sign-off. Aim for sign-offs by 16:00 PT so I can schedule publishing and the announcement email.
Maria G: I'll do a final content pass at 14:00 PT and then ping for reviews.
Jordan K: Will attach one more set of logs and the perf dashboard link.
Legal - Tina: If everything is in the doc, I'll add an approval comment after 15:30 PT.
Alex P: Awesome — thanks everyone. If there are no blockers I will schedule Monday 09:00 PT publish + webinar invites. :rocket:
Maria G: LGTM
Sam L: :thumbsup:
